title: CEI violation in stake/withdraw/claim (debt settled after phUSD.mint / rewardToken.transfer, no nonReentrant) -> conditional re-entry N-claim
description: _claimRewards mints phUSD (L442) and transfers reward (L448) BEFORE the caller rebases phUSDDebt/stableDebt (debt is set after _claimRewards returns in claim/stake/withdraw); none of stake/withdraw/claim carry nonReentrant. Under the in-scope standard-ERC20 phUSD (no mint callback) and standard stablecoin reward, this is NOT triggerable. IF a callback-capable reward/phUSD token (ERC777/hooked) were ever wired, an attacker's transfer/mint hook could re-enter claim() with stale debt and repeatedly draw payout (conditional High / over-mint).
impact: Defense-in-depth gap only under current scope. No demonstrated trigger on the deployed standard token set. Conditional escalation to High exists ONLY if a hook/callback token is introduced onto the reward/phUSD path - which is outside the in-scope token set and on the known-invalid list.
attackPath: 1. (Conditional) reward or phUSD token has a transfer/mint hook.
2. _claimRewards mints phUSD (L442) / transfers reward (L448) BEFORE the caller rebases phUSDDebt/stableDebt; stake/withdraw/claim lack nonReentrant.
3. Hook re-enters claim() with stale debt -> repeated payout.
4. Not reachable today: phUSD.mint has no callback and the stable reward is a standard ERC20.
recommendation: Follow checks-effects-interactions: rebase phUSDDebt/stableDebt before the external mint/transfer, and/or add a nonReentrant guard to stake/withdraw/claim, as defense-in-depth that future-proofs against any hooked-token wiring.
corroboratingSources: PATTERN-004 phUSD double-mint folded as impact facet (same root, no independent trigger)

tier3Verification.detail: Conditional: not triggerable on in-scope tokens; conditional-High documented but not assigned (rests on out-of-scope token assumption).

borderlineFlag: Conditional: escalates to High ONLY if a hook/callback token is introduced onto the reward/phUSD path; under in-scope tokens it is Low.
